messages.subject: CSV on shiny online
parts:
Hello,
     I have shiny apps running for monitoring data, to make them running faster I work on my local database on I hourly upload a csv on an external ftp which I call from shiny. The question is: Is it possible to upload directly on the shiny online directory my csv so i can bypass the external ftp  which makes me often some troubles? I would like to upload the csv from my local R script not from shiny.

Many thanks

MV

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: CSV on shiny online
parts:
It is not currently possible to upload data directly to the running shinyapps.io application.

Per the documentation, the storage should be considered ephemeral, and it will go away once the application goes to sleep.

Persistent storage is on our roadmap, but we can't say what the timeline might be.
